To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
milk yield was not affected but milk fat percentage decreased during diet-induced milk fat depression and recovery occurred gradually when dietary fiber and lipid concentrations were corrected.
recovery from diet-induced milk fat depression occurs in 2 phases.
milk fat depression (MDF) recovery from a low-fiber/high-oil diet occurs gradually with a 5-d lag when dietary fiber concentration is increased and dietary oil is decreased.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms by which milk fat depression is induced in dairy cattle and how the cow recovers from this condition.
the effects of dietary fatty acids on the biohydrogenation of unsaturated fatty acids in dairy cows.
the effects of diet-induced milk fat depression (MDF) on milk fat synthesis and composition in dairy cows.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
recovery from diet-induced milk fat depression occurs gradually with a lag period, and is associated with a progressive reduction in trans isomers of C18:1 FA.
the recovery from milk fat suppression is biphasic, and the first phase is characterized by the rapid disappearance of trans-10 C 18:1 and its isomers.
the time to recovery of milk fat production from a diet-induced MFD event is a function of the time to recovery from the effects of the intermediates of biohydrogenation that caused the MFD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MFD is a complex process that occurs over time, is not a simple on/off phenomenon, and is influenced by many factors.

the time course of induction of MFD is biphasic and that the time course for recovery from MFD occurs in 3 phases: an immediate phase, a second phase of delayed recovery, and a third phase where milk fat concentration and yield are not different from controls.
MFD is caused by a combination of factors that include trans-10 C16:1, trans-10 C17:1, and trans-10, cis-12 CLA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the recovery from milk fat suppression is not immediate and can take 2 to 3 wk.
the time course of MFD and recovery is biphasic and that the time course is similar during induction and recovery from MFD.
MFD is a dynamic condition that is not easily reversed, and that recovery occurs in a stepwise process that is not instantaneous.
